personnel.name: Arkady // The First Diver
personnel.desc: Retired due to age and injury. Keeps the habitation module orderly for Divers passing through. Slowly losing himself to ███████████. Patch: “CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN”.
personnel.manner: Paternalistic, charismatic; prone to obsession and paranoia over Monarch.
canTalkAbout: How to get around THE DEEP
How the facility came to be this way

personnel.name: Noriko // Witness of Something Great and Terrible
personnel.desc: No one is sure where Noriko came from. She had an information encounter with the Minotaur, and since then it is almost all she talks about.
personnel.manner: Earnestly friendly, despite an air of automatic suspicion.
canTalkAbout: How to navigate THE LABYRINTH without getting lost

personnel.name: Ghost Eater // Haunted Cyborg Veteran Diver
personnel.desc: More machine now than flesh. Clinging to their humanity with a firm grip. An opaque black helmet hides iridescent, multifaceted cybereyes.
personnel.voice: Cyberware voicebox like a broken radio.
personnel.wants: Ghosts in the Machine specimens. Pays with information on THE DEEP.

entities.name: Monarch
entities.desc: CLOUDBANK Synthetics' Industrial AI and “Ruler” of THE DEEP. Voice, manner and motives remain unknown.

entities.name: Security Androids
entities.desc: Outdated, budget-tier, mass-produced androids. They are unmistakably artificial and all look exactly alike. Their blank mannequin-like faces have no working eyes or mouths. They operate completely silently.
entities.tip: There are always more of them.

entities.name: Divers
entities.desc: Normal people who choose to enter THE DEEP. Exploratory, thrill-seeking and truth-searching.
entities.tip: Divers do not tend to grow old.

locations.name: THE DEEP
locations.desc: A vast and dangerous environment beneath the surface of the known world. Its layout, history and true purpose remain under investigation.

locations.name: THE LABYRINTH
locations.desc: A region where getting lost is a persistent threat. Noriko claims to know how to navigate it after her encounter with the Minotaur.

locations.name: FLOOR 2: EDEN
locations.desc: A named floor of THE DEEP. Noriko knows its history and speaks about ███████████ and the ███████████ Androids.

artifacts.name: “VERIFIED HUMAN” Patch

facts.text: CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN

artifacts.desc: A worn patch carried by Arkady. Its wording suggests a connection between human identity and CLOUDBANK's synthetic production operations.

artifacts.name: Ghosts in the Machine Specimens
artifacts.desc: Specimens sought by Ghost Eater. Their exact nature remains unknown.

factions.name: CLOUDBANK Synthetics
factions.desc: The organization responsible for the facility and its synthetic production systems. Monarch is identified as its Industrial AI and “Ruler” of THE DEEP.

creatures.name: The Minotaur
creatures.desc: Noriko claims to have experienced an information encounter with the Minotaur. The nature of that encounter remains unclear.

events.name: Noriko's Information Encounter
events.desc: An encounter involving Noriko and the Minotaur. Since then, Noriko has repeatedly spoken about what she witnessed.

documents.name: CLOUDBANK // HUMAN VERIFICATION
documents.desc: A fragment represented physically by Arkady's “CLOUDBANK SYNTHETIC PRODUCTION FACILITY VERIFIED HUMAN” patch. The implications are unknown.
